categories.title: Fast Travel
categories.info: Fast Travel points will spawn you at a designated spot of the map as a specific character, remembering your previous loadout with them. Seven Fast Travel points are only unlocked once you unlock a character via a Grand Prix cup.
categories.template: Spawns you at the Yoshi Diner as ??.

categories.title: Yoshi Diner
categories.info: Yoshi Diners give you a given food item of random size that gives a boost and changes a main character's outfit. The bigger the meal, the bigger the boost!

categories.title: Yoshi Food Truck
categories.info: Yoshi Food Trucks work just like Yoshi Diners: they give you a given food item of random size that gives a boost and changes a main character's outfit. The bigger the meal, the bigger the boost!

categories.title: P-Switch
categories.info: Run over a P-Switch to test your driving skills and earn a unique Sticker!

categories.title: Peach Medallion
categories.info: Floating golden coins that, when collected, award a random sticker from the "Medallions & Milestones" pool.

categories.title: Question Mark Panel
categories.info: Flat yellow panels that award a specific Sticker when you touch them. After quitting the game, collected ? Panels will give 5 Coins when driven over again.

categories.title: Character
categories.info: Unlockable characters. Abduct them by hijacking a UFO, usually guaranteed to be found nearby or can be found randomly spawning on roads.

categories.title: Easter Egg
categories.info: Well-hidden temporary vehicles that can be used to fly and a abduct characters, unlocking them easily.
